intent: Extract a portable Effect-native agent kernel with explicit agents, modules, middleware, journals, and host-owned RPC supervision.

findings.title: Journal append failure became a defect
findings.suggested_fix: Propagate JournalAppendError through the model stream.

findings.title: Kernel does not enforce safe retry state
findings.suggested_fix: Control retries after visible output or tool dispatch.

findings.title: Required characterization coverage is incomplete
findings.suggested_fix: Restore timeout, concurrency, limits, reasoning, and invalid-parameter tests.

findings.title: Extension proof coverage is incomplete
findings.suggested_fix: Run all six public examples and add child failure and cancellation proofs.

findings.title: Recovery matches reused tool IDs without step namespace
findings.suggested_fix: Use a durable run, turn, step, and call correlation key.

findings.title: Direct plans kept blank instruction fragments

residual_risks: The package is experimental and uses effect/unstable/ai.

suppressed_findings: Unknown-tool behavior is a settled design decision.
